target.title: fix(cli): exit after hooks inspection output
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh the hooks inspection exit fix onto current `main`
- keep `hooks list`, `hooks info`, `hooks check`, `hooks enable`, `hooks disable`, and bare `hooks` as one-shot CLI commands
- keep relay and deprecated install/update paths unchanged
- remove stale changelog/LSP incidental hunks from the PR surface

## What Problem This Solves

Plugin diagnostics can load hook/plugin code. If a plugin/register path leaves a timer/socket/other handle open after the hooks command has already printed its inspection output, the CLI can hang in non-interactive use. These commands are inspection or one-shot mutation commands, so after successful output they should drain stdout/stderr and exit cleanly.

## Scope / risk

- PR diff is limited to `src/cli/hooks-cli.ts` and `src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`.
- No changelog/release-owned files in the refreshed diff.
- No LSP/runtime incidental hunks remain.
- Relay plus deprecated install/update flows still use the normal hooks action wrapper, not the one-shot exit wrapper.
- Vitest workers and custom runtimes are excluded from forced exit behavior.

## Current head

- Head: `e7e9505251`
- GitHub mergeability after push: `MERGEABLE`; checks are recomputing on the refreshed head.
- PR diff vs current `main`: 2 files, 143 insertions / 9 deletions.

## Evidence

Local verification after refreshing onto current `main`:

- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts src/infra/gateway-boot-lifecycle.ts src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.ts`
- `corepack pnpm test src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts` — 6 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm test test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts` — 41 tests passed; this covers the previously failing CI shard after refreshing onto latest `main`
- `corepack pnpm check:no-conflict-markers`
- `corepack pnpm check:madge-import-cycles` — 0 cycles
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`

Behavior evidence:

- The refreshed regression test directly covers the maintainer concern: it simulates a plugin/register-style lingering handle after inspection output, verifies the one-shot hooks helper waits for stdout/stderr drain callbacks, and only then invokes `defaultRuntime.exit(0)`.
- The earlier real CLI proof also remains relevant: `pnpm openclaw hooks list --json` completed with exit code 0 before a watchdog timeout on this branch. The refreshed branch keeps that behavior while reducing the PR surface to the hooks CLI files only.
